statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of presyncope and transient loss of consciousness without prodromal warning
There is concern for an underlying paroxysmal arrhythmia
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was to correlate syncopal events with potential rhythm disturbances
The diagnosis codes are I49.9 and R55
The claim was denied under reason code CO-197
The service was denied because required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the date of service
